title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-25 03:28:01 最新章节：未命名95
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
玄黄大陆，千风王国，落霞郡，叶家！
一名瘦骨如柴的白衣少年正躺在床上，奄奄一息！
突然一道白光涌入少年身体中，片刻后，少年惊叫了起来，
“啊……，痛死我了！这是哪里？”
“少爷，少爷，你终于醒了！”
一名少女面带泪珠，激动的看着少年。
少年看着旁边梳着两根马尾辫，面色清瘦，一双杏眼眨巴眨巴的看着自己，满脸泪痕的绿衣少女。
少女名叫叶月儿，是叶辰的丫鬟。
少年一时间，脑海中闪烁着无数的记忆片段，慢慢的融合在一起。
叶辰，本是仙界仙帝，为了寻找永恒之谜，进入了葬神谷，希望能找到永生的办法，无奈葬神谷凶险异常，诡异莫测。
葬神谷乃是仙界第一禁地。几万年来，多少仙尊为寻求永生，踏足葬神谷，探寻永恒之谜，最终都落得个了无音讯。
叶辰刚刚突破仙帝之境，自以为是仙界第一！
便想着探寻葬神谷之谜，冒险踏足了葬神谷，到处都是空间乱流，电闪雷鸣。
强大的威压压制了神识，迷雾重重，尘埃弥漫，不知名的气体笼罩，让人无法修炼，突然一道金光冲入了体内。
瞬间，叶辰体内仙力逐渐消失。境界不稳，不得已拼着九死一生先退出葬神谷。
刚出葬神谷，好兄弟秦擎天与恋人吕白雪在谷外默默等着自己，这让叶辰感动不已。
“擎天啊，这葬神谷果然是凶险异常，差点身死道消！无功而返，一无所获！”叶辰苦笑一声，无奈的抱怨一下。
“我们先回去吧，我感觉到仙力一直在渐渐消失，境界不稳，我们抓紧时间回去吧！”
秦擎天脸上露出一丝诧异，不着痕迹的看了一眼吕白雪，“大哥，这次真的没有收获吗？？？”
叶辰愣了一下，“擎天，我们几千年在一起出生入死，大哥何时骗过你和白雪”

说话间，叶辰的境界已经降到了仙尊之境！仙力在缓慢的消失着，丝毫没有停下来的意思。
“大哥，我没别的意思！你受伤了我们先回去吧！”秦擎天看着境界不稳的叶辰。心中暗自盘算着什么，不着痕迹的看了吕白雪一眼。
“走吧！这次莫名其妙的境界一直在下降，回去之后我就闭关，仙界之事就暂时由你和白雪掌管”。叶辰忧心忡忡，丝毫没有注意到秦擎天的异样。
白雪上前搀扶着叶辰，“叶辰哥哥，你放心，小雪一定帮你守护好仙界！”
吕白雪回头看了一眼秦擎天，秦擎天微微点了一下头。
秦擎天手中突然出现了一把漆黑如墨的匕首噬魂匕，迅雷不及掩耳之势从后背捅向了叶辰。
content_en:
Xuanhuang Continent, Qianfeng Kingdom, Luoxia County, Ye Family!
A skinny boy in white clothes was lying on the bed, dying!
Suddenly a white light poured into the boy's body. After a moment, the boy screamed,
"Ah..., it hurts me to death! Where is this?"
"Master, Master, you finally woke up!"
A girl looked at the boy excitedly with tears on her face.
The young man looked at the girl in green next to him, who had two ponytails, a thin face, a pair of almond-shaped eyes blinking at him, and a face full of tears.
The girl's name is Ye Yue'er, and she is Ye Chen's maid.
For a time, countless memory fragments flashed in the young man's mind, slowly merging together.
Ye Chen, who was originally the Immortal Emperor of the Immortal Realm, entered the God Burial Valley in search of the eternal mystery, hoping to find a way to live forever. However, the God Burial Valley was extremely dangerous and unpredictable.
The God Burial Valley is the most forbidden place in the immortal world. For tens of thousands of years, in pursuit of eternal life, many immortals have set foot in the God Burial Valley to explore the eternal mystery, but in the end there was no news.
Ye Chen had just broken through to the realm of the Immortal Emperor and thought he was the number one in the Immortal Realm!
Thinking of exploring the mystery of the Valley of the Buried Gods, I ventured into the Valley of the Buried Gods. There were turbulent flows of space, lightning and thunder everywhere.
The powerful pressure suppressed the consciousness, the fog was thick, the dust was thick, and the unknown gas shrouded people, making it impossible to practice. Suddenly, a golden light rushed into the body.
In an instant, the immortal power in Ye Chen's body gradually disappeared. The realm is unstable, and he has no choice but to escape from the God Burial Valley with a narrow escape.
Just after leaving the God Burial Valley, his good brother Qin Qingtian and his lover Lu Baixue were waiting for him silently outside the valley, which moved Ye Chen deeply.
"Qingtian, this God Burial Valley is really dangerous and dangerous. I almost died! I returned in vain and got nothing!" Ye Chen gave a bitter smile and complained helplessly.
"Let's go back first. I feel that the immortal power has been gradually disappearing and the realm is unstable. Let's hurry up and go back!"
There was a hint of surprise on Qin Qingtian's face, and he glanced at Lu Baixue without any trace, "Brother, are you really not gaining anything this time???"
Ye Chen was stunned for a moment, "Qingtian, we have been together through life and death for thousands of years. When did eldest brother lie to you and Bai Xue?"
While speaking, Ye Chen's level has dropped to that of an immortal! The immortal power is slowly disappearing, with no intention of stopping.
"Brother, I don't mean anything else! You're injured, let's go back first!" Qin Qingtian looked at Ye Chen, who was in an unstable state. He was secretly calculating something in his heart and glanced at Lu Baixue without any trace.
"Let's go! This time, the inexplicable state has been declining. After I go back, I will go into seclusion. You and Bai Xue will be in charge of the affairs of the fairy world for the time being." Ye Chen was so worried that he didn't notice anything strange about Qin Qingtian.
Bai Xue stepped forward to help Ye Chen, "Brother Ye Chen, don't worry, Xiaoxue will definitely help you protect the fairy world!"
Lu Baixue looked back at Qin Qingtian, who nodded slightly.
A dagger as black as ink suddenly appeared in Qin Qingtian's hand, the Soul-Eating Dagger, and he stabbed Ye Chen from the back with lightning speed.
